title: Airborne software assurance and airworthiness security
description: Preselected for aerospace: keep it when the organization develops software, or information systems, that run on board an aircraft, engine, propeller or ETSO article under an EASA or FAA approval (ED-12C / DO-178C, ED-202A / DO-326A through EASA AMC 20-115D and AMC 20-42). It does not apply to ground software, whose assurance standard the authority names, or to a state aircraft, which Regulation (EU) 2018/1139 leaves out (Art. 2(3)). The standards are sold by RTCA and EUROCAE, and these rules never replace the authority's agreement.
